facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/dobj:HSD_DObjDisp
facts.version_note: updated_at is the frozen fact version exposed by the API.
facts.value: The input DObj's mobj pointer flows first into HSD_MObjSetCurrent and then into the material setup and unset virtual methods. The DObj's pobj pointer seeds a next-linked traversal; each PObj receives vmtx, pmtx, and rendermode unchanged through its display virtual method. On exit, NULL is passed to HSD_MObjSetCurrent, so no material pointer is returned or retained as the current context by this routine.
facts.reason: TU review: material setup/unset callbacks are conditional on rendermode bit0x04000000 being clear; unconditional data-flow claim needs qualification.

facts.subject: src/sysdolphin/baselib/dobj.c
facts.version_note: updated_at is the frozen fact version exposed by the API.
facts.value: Descriptor data flows into recursively allocated DObj nodes whose next, MObj, and PObj fields are populated from the corresponding descriptor links; material render-mode bits are converted into DObj display flags. Animation descriptors, start frames, and masks are then forwarded through each DObj to its polygon and material attachments. During post-load fixup, runtime DObj and HSD_DObjDesc lists are paired through their next links and each PObj list is resolved against the corresponding pobjdesc list. During display, the DObj's MObj becomes the current material, establishes render state, and encloses traversal of the attached PObj display methods before that state is cleared.
facts.reason: TU review: material setup/unset callbacks are conditional on rendermode bit0x04000000 being clear; unconditional data-flow claim needs qualification.
